name: Rowbike Avatar (Experiment)
description: Experimental 3D Rowbike 720 Sport + animated rowing avatar replacement for your rider in Biketerra.

settings.label: Activation mode
settings.description: auto = individually replace each rider (you and/or other riders) who has sport: 1 in the biketerra-ride broadcast channel; always = replace your ego avatar immediately; off = disabled.

settings.label: Rower avatar
settings.description: real = animate your actual Biketerra player avatar (jersey, helmet, face, shadows) on the Rowbike; stylized = procedural fallback rower.

settings.label: Rowbike color theme
settings.description: rider_bike = use each rider's Biketerra bike_frame_color for the frame, its opposite/complementary color for the rowing lever, and bike_sidewall_color for the tires; custom = use the custom colors below.

settings.label: Custom rail & frame color
settings.description: Primary frame / sliding seat rail color when 'custom' is selected (720 Sport red by default).

settings.label: Custom rowing lever color
settings.description: Pivoting rowing power arm color when 'custom' is selected (720 Sport blue by default).
